title.zh: 卷八十七 志第三十七: 百官三
title.raw: 卷八十七 志第三十七: 百官三 Volume 87 Treatises 40: Official Posts 3

sentences.zh: 百官三

translations.literal: Official Posts 3
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts 3

sentences.zh: 大宗正府，秩從一品。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Clan; rank, Junior First Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of the Imperial Clan held the rank of Junior First Rank.

sentences.zh: 國初未有官制，首置斷事官，曰劄魯忽赤，會決庶務。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state there was not yet an official system; they first established judges called jarquchi, who met to decide general affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the dynasty was first founded, no formal bureaucracy yet existed; the first officials appointed were judges known as jarquchi, who convened to adjudicate routine business.

sentences.zh: 凡諸王駙馬投下蒙古、色目人等，應犯一切公事，及漢人奸盜詐偽、蠱毒厭魅、誘掠逃驅、輕重罪囚，及邊遠出征官吏、每歲從駕分司上都存留住冬諸事，悉掌之。

translations.literal: All princes, imperial sons-in-law, appanage holders, Mongols, semuren, and the like who committed any public offense, as well as Han Chinese cases of theft, fraud, sorcery, witchcraft, enticement, flight, and abduction, serious and light criminal prisoners, frontier officials on campaign, and each year those who remained at Shangdu on winter duty while the court accompanied the emperor—all were entirely under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: It had jurisdiction over all public offenses by princes, imperial sons-in-law, appanage holders, Mongols, semuren, and others; over Han Chinese crimes of theft, fraud, poisoning, witchcraft, enticement, flight, and abduction; over prisoners charged with serious or minor offenses; over officials on distant campaigns; and over each year’s staff who remained at Shangdu for winter duty while the court was away—all such matters fell entirely within its purview.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，置十員。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, ten posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 2 (1265), ten posts were established.

sentences.zh: 三年，置八員。

translations.literal: In the third year, eight posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, eight posts were established.

sentences.zh: 九年，降從一品銀印，止理蒙古公事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, it was reduced to a silver seal of Junior First Rank and handled only Mongol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, its seal was downgraded to Junior First Rank in silver, and it dealt only with Mongol affairs.

sentences.zh: 以諸王為府長，余悉御位下及諸王之有國封者。

translations.literal: Princes served as directors of the office; the rest were all from the imperial succession or princes holding state fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Princes served as heads of the office; the remaining appointees were drawn from the imperial line or from princes who held state fiefs.

sentences.zh: 又有怯薛人員，奉旨署事，別無頒受宣命。

translations.literal: There were also keshig personnel who received imperial orders to handle business but received no formal appointment patent.
translations.idiomatic: Keshig personnel also carried out duties by imperial order, though they received no formal appointment patent.

sentences.zh: 十四年，置十四員。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, fourteen posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, fourteen posts were established.

sentences.zh: 十五年，置十三員。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, thirteen posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, thirteen posts were established.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，置二十一員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, twenty-one posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, twenty-one posts were established.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，增至三十四員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, it was increased to thirty-four posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, the number was raised to thirty-four posts.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，增至四十六員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, it was increased to forty-six posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, it was increased to forty-six posts.

sentences.zh: 大德四年，省五員。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dade, five posts were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 4 (1300), five posts were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 十一年，四十一員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, forty-one posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, there were forty-one posts.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，省二員，以漢人刑名歸刑部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing, two posts were cut, and Han Chinese penal cases were transferred to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 (1312), two posts were cut, and Han Chinese penal matters were assigned to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，復命兼理，置劄魯忽赤四十二員，令史改為掾史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding, joint jurisdiction was restored; forty-two jarquchi were appointed, and clerks were renamed secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 (1324), joint jurisdiction was restored; forty-two jarquchi were appointed, and clerks were redesignated secretaries.

sentences.zh: 致和元年，以上都、大都所屬蒙古人並怯薛軍站色目與漢人相犯者，歸宗正府處斷，其餘路府州縣漢人、蒙古、色目詞訟，悉歸有司刑部掌管。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, cases in which Mongols and semuren of Shangdu and Dadu, including keshig military stations, clashed with Han Chinese were adjudicated by the Court of the Imperial Clan; all other lawsuits among Han Chinese, Mongols, and semuren in circuits, prefectures, and counties were handled by the regular offices and the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 1 (1328), offenses involving Mongols and semuren under Shangdu and Dadu—including those at keshig military stations—against Han Chinese were adjudicated by the Court of the Imperial Clan; all other litigation among Han Chinese, Mongols, and semuren in circuits, prefectures, and counties was assigned to the regular local offices and the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 正官劄魯忽赤四十二員，從一品；

translations.literal: Chief jarquchi, forty-two posts, Junior First Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Chief jarquchi: forty-two posts, Junior First Rank;

sentences.zh: 郎中二員，從五品；

translations.literal: Directors, two posts, Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Directors: two posts, Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 員外郎二員，從六品；

translations.literal: Vice directors, two posts, Junior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors: two posts, Junior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 都事二員，從七品；

translations.literal: Chief clerks, two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks: two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 承發架閣庫管勾一員，從八品；

translations.literal: Registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository, one post, Junior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository: one post, Junior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史十人，蒙古必阇赤十三人，通事、知印各三人，宣使十人，蒙古書寫一人，典吏三人，庫子一人，醫人一人，司獄二員。

translations.literal: Ten secretaries, thirteen Mongol bitikchi, three interpreters and seal keepers each, ten dispatchers, one Mongol scribe, three record clerks, one storekeeper, one physician, two prison wardens.
translations.idiomatic: Staff included ten secretaries, thirteen Mongol bitikchi, three interpreters and three seal keepers, ten dispatchers, one Mongol scribe, three record clerks, one storekeeper, one physician, and two prison wardens.

sentences.zh: 大司農司，秩正二品，凡農桑、水利、學校、饑荒之事，悉掌之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Imperial Farms; rank, Senior Second Rank; it had charge of agriculture, sericulture, waterworks, schools, and famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Imperial Farms ranked at Senior Second Rank and oversaw agriculture, sericulture, irrigation, schools, and famine relief.

sentences.zh: 至元七年始立，置官五員。

translations.literal: It was first established in the seventh year of Zhiyuan, with five officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was first established in Zhiyuan 7 (1270), with five officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 十四年罷，以按察司兼領勸農事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it was abolished, and the surveillance commissions were made to oversee agricultural encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year it was abolished, and the surveillance commissions were charged with promoting agriculture.

sentences.zh: 十八年，改立農政院，置官六員。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Agricultural Policy Office was established in its place, with six officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Agricultural Policy Office was established in its place, with six officials.

sentences.zh: 二十年，又改立務農司，秩從三品，置達魯花赤一員、務農使一員、同知二員。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was again renamed the Bureau for Promoting Agriculture, rank Junior Third Rank, with one darughachi, one commissioner for promoting agriculture, and two associate commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year it was renamed again as the Bureau for Promoting Agriculture, rank Junior Third Rank, with one darughachi, one commissioner for promoting agriculture, and two associate commissioners.

sentences.zh: 是年，又改司農寺，達魯花赤一員，司農卿二員，司丞一員。

translations.literal: That year it was again renamed the Directorate of Imperial Farms, with one darughachi, two directors of imperial farms, and one vice director.
translations.idiomatic: That same year it became the Directorate of Imperial Farms, with one darughachi, two directors, and one vice director.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，仍為大司農司，秩仍正二品。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was restored as the Ministry of Imperial Farms, rank still Senior Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year it was restored as the Ministry of Imperial Farms, still at Senior Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，增領大司農事一員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dade, one post of overseer of imperial farms was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 1 (1297), one post of overseer of imperial farms was added.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，升從一品，增大司農一員。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing it was promoted to Junior First Rank, and one post of grand overseer of imperial farms was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 2 (1313) it was promoted to Junior First Rank, and one post of grand overseer was added.

sentences.zh: 定置大司農四員，從一品；

translations.literal: Fixed establishment: grand overseers of imperial farms, four posts, Junior First Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Fixed posts: grand overseers of imperial farms, four posts, Junior First Rank;

sentences.zh: 大司農卿二員，正二品；

translations.literal: Directors of imperial farms, two posts, Senior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Directors of imperial farms, two posts, Senior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 少卿二員，從二品；

translations.literal: Vice directors, two posts, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors, two posts, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 大司農丞二員，從三品；

translations.literal: Vice directors of imperial farms, two posts, Junior Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Assistant directors of imperial farms, two posts, Junior Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 經歷一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Administrative aide, one post, Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Administrative aide: one post, Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 都事二員，從七品；

translations.literal: Chief clerks, two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks: two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 架閣庫管勾一員，照磨一員，並正八品；

translations.literal: Registrar of the document repository and proofreader, one post each, both Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Registrar of the document repository and proofreader, one post each, both Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史十二人，蒙古必阇赤二人，回回掾史一人，知印二人，通事一人，宣使一人，典吏五人。

translations.literal: Twelve secretaries, two Mongol bitikchi, one Muslim secretary, two seal keepers, one interpreter, one dispatcher, five record clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve secretaries, two Mongol bitikchi, one Muslim secretary, two seal keepers, one interpreter, one dispatcher, and five record clerks.

sentences.zh: 籍田署，秩從六品，掌耕種籍田，以奉宗廟祭祀。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Field Office, rank Junior Sixth Rank, managed cultivation of the ceremonial field to supply ancestral temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Field Office, rank Junior Sixth Rank, oversaw cultivation of the ceremonial field for ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 至元七年始立，隸大司農。

translations.literal: It was first established in the seventh year of Zhiyuan and was subordinate to the Ministry of Imperial Farms.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Zhiyuan 7, it was subordinate to the Ministry of Imperial Farms.

sentences.zh: 十四年，罷司農，隸太常寺。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the directorate of farms was abolished and it was placed under the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, when the farm directorate was abolished, it was placed under the Directorate of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，復立大司農司，仍隸焉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Ministry of Imperial Farms was re-established and it remained subordinate thereto.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the ministry was re-established and the office remained under it.

sentences.zh: 署令一員，從六品；

translations.literal: Office director, one post, Junior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Office director: one post, Junior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 署丞一員，從七品；

translations.literal: Office vice director, one post, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Office vice director: one post, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 司吏一人。

translations.literal: One clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One clerk.

sentences.zh: 供膳司，秩從五品。

translations.literal: The Provisions Bureau, rank Junior Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Provisions Bureau, rank Junior Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌供給應需，貨買百色生料，並桑哥籍入貲產。

translations.literal: It supplied necessities, purchased all kinds of raw materials in quantity, and managed property confiscated from Sangü’s household.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied daily needs, purchased raw materials of every kind, and administered property seized from Sangü’s estate.

sentences.zh: 至元二十二年始置，隸司農。

translations.literal: It was first established in the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan and was subordinate to the farm directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Zhiyuan 22 (1285), it was subordinate to the farm directorate.

sentences.zh: 置達魯花赤一員，提點一員，並從五品；

translations.literal: One darughachi and one intendant, both Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: One darughachi and one intendant, both Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 司令一員，正六品；

translations.literal: Bureau director, one post, Senior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director: one post, Senior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 丞一員，正七品；

translations.literal: Vice director, one post, Senior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Vice director: one post, Senior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 吏一人。

translations.literal: One clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One clerk.

sentences.zh: 輔用庫，秩正九品。

translations.literal: The Auxiliary Treasury, rank Senior Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Auxiliary Treasury, rank Senior Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 掌規運息錢，以給供需。

translations.literal: It managed the circulation of interest-bearing funds to supply provisions.
translations.idiomatic: It managed revolving interest funds to meet supply needs.

sentences.zh: 大使一員，副使一員。

translations.literal: One commissioner and one vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: One commissioner and one vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 興中州等處油戶提領所，秩從九品。

translations.literal: The Oil Households Intendant Office at Xingzhong and elsewhere, rank Junior Ninth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Oil Households Intendant Office at Xingzhong and elsewhere, rank Junior Ninth Rank.

sentences.zh: 提領一員，大使一員，副使一員。

translations.literal: One intendant, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: One intendant, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 歲辦油十萬斤，以供內庖。

translations.literal: Each year it supplied one hundred thousand jin of oil for the inner kitchens.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied one hundred thousand jin of oil annually for the imperial kitchens.

sentences.zh: 至元二十九年始置。

translations.literal: It was first established in the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was first established in Zhiyuan 29 (1292).

sentences.zh: 蔚州面戶提領所，提領一員，副使一員。

translations.literal: The Flour Households Intendant Office at Weizhou: one intendant and one vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Flour Households Intendant Office at Weizhou: one intendant and one vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 掌辦白面蔥菜，以給應辦，歲計十餘萬斤。

translations.literal: It supplied white flour and scallions to meet requirements, totaling more than one hundred thousand jin per year.
translations.idiomatic: It provided white flour and scallions as required, totaling more than one hundred thousand jin per year.

sentences.zh: 右屬供膳。

translations.literal: The above were subordinate to the Provisions Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The offices listed above were subordinate to the Provisions Bureau.

sentences.zh: 永平屯田總管府，秩從三品。

translations.literal: The Yongping Colonies General Directorate, rank Junior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongping Colonies General Directorate, rank Junior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 達魯花赤一員，總管一員，同知一員，知事一員，司吏四人。

translations.literal: One darughachi, one director-general, one associate director, one administrative officer, four clerks.
translations.idiomatic: One darughachi, one director-general, one associate director, one administrative officer, and four clerks.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，始立於永平路南馬城縣，以北京采木三千人隸之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan it was first established at Machang County in Yongping Circuit, with three thousand timber cutters from the Northern Capital placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Zhiyuan 24 (1287) at Machang County in Yongping Circuit, it took charge of three thousand timber cutters from the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 所轄昌國、濟民、豐贍三署，各置署令一員、署丞一員、直長一人、吏目二人、吏二人。

translations.literal: It governed three offices—Changguo, Jimin, and Fengshan—each with one office director, one vice director, one chief steward, two clerical heads, and two clerks.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw three sub-offices—Changguo, Jimin, and Fengshan—each with one director, one vice director, one chief steward, two clerical heads, and two clerks.

sentences.zh: 翰林兼國史院，秩正二品。

translations.literal: The Hanlin Academy combined with the National History Office, rank Senior Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy combined with the National History Office, rank Senior Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 中統初，以王鶚為翰林學士承旨，未立官署。

translations.literal: In the early Zhongtong period Wang E was made Hanlin academician and grand preceptor, but no office was yet established.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhongtong era Wang E served as Hanlin academician and grand preceptor, though no formal agency yet existed.

sentences.zh: 至元元年始置，秩正三品。

translations.literal: It was first established in the first year of Zhiyuan, rank Senior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: It was first established in Zhiyuan 1 (1264) at Senior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 六年，置承旨三員、學士二員、侍讀學士二員、侍講學士二員、直學士二員。

translations.literal: In the sixth year there were appointed three grand preceptors, two academicians, two reader-academicians, two lecturer-academicians, and two regular academicians.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year three grand preceptors, two academicians, two reader-academicians, two lecturer-academicians, and two regular academicians were appointed.

sentences.zh: 八年，升從二品。

translations.literal: In the eighth year it was promoted to Junior Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year it was promoted to Junior Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 十四年，增承旨一員。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year one grand preceptor was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year one grand preceptor was added.

sentences.zh: 十六年，增侍讀學士一員。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year one reader-academician was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year one reader-academician was added.

sentences.zh: 十七年，增承旨二員。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year two grand preceptors were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year two grand preceptors were added.

sentences.zh: 二十年，省並集賢院為翰林國史集賢院。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Academy of Scholarly Worthies was merged with it into the Hanlin and National History and Academy of Scholarly Worthies Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Academy of Scholarly Worthies was merged into the Hanlin, National History, and Academy of Scholarly Worthies Office.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，增學士二員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year two academicians were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year two academicians were added.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，復分立集賢院。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the Academy of Scholarly Worthies was again separated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Academy of Scholarly Worthies was separated again.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，增侍講學士一員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year one lecturer-academician was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year one lecturer-academician was added.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，置官吏五員，掌管教習亦思替非文字。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year five officials were appointed to teach and train in the ’Phags-pa script.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year five officials were appointed to teach the ’Phags-pa script.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，增承旨一員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year one grand preceptor was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year one grand preceptor was added.

sentences.zh: 大德九年，升正二品，改典簿為司直，置都事一員。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Dade it was promoted to Senior Second Rank; the registry clerk was renamed administrative aide, and one chief clerk post was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 9 (1305) it was promoted to Senior Second Rank; the registry clerk was redesignated administrative aide, and one chief clerk post was added.

sentences.zh: 至大元年，置承旨九員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhida nine grand preceptors were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 1 (1308) nine grand preceptors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，升從一品，改司直為經歷。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing it was promoted to Junior First Rank, and the administrative aide was renamed administrative director.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 (1312) it was promoted to Junior First Rank, and the administrative aide was renamed administrative director.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年，別置回回國子監學，以掌亦思替非官屬歸之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanyou a separate Muslim Imperial College was established, and the ’Phags-pa staff were transferred to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 1 (1314) a separate Muslim Imperial College was established, and the ’Phags-pa staff were assigned to it.

sentences.zh: 五年，置承旨八員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year eight grand preceptors were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year eight grand preceptors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 後定置承旨六員，從一品；

translations.literal: Later fixed establishment: grand preceptors, six posts, Junior First Rank;
translations.idiomatic: The later fixed establishment: grand preceptors, six posts, Junior First Rank;

sentences.zh: 學士二員，正二品；

translations.literal: Academicians, two posts, Senior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Academicians, two posts, Senior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士二員，從二品；

translations.literal: Reader-academicians, two posts, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Reader-academicians, two posts, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 侍講學士二員，從二品；

translations.literal: Lecturer-academicians, two posts, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer-academicians, two posts, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 直學士二員，從三品。

translations.literal: Regular academicians, two posts, Junior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Regular academicians, two posts, Junior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 屬官：待制五員，正五品；

translations.literal: Subordinate officials: attendants, five posts, Senior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officials: attendants, five posts, Senior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 修撰三員，從六品；

translations.literal: Compiler-historians, three posts, Junior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Compiler-historians, three posts, Junior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 應奉翰林文字五員，從七品；

translations.literal: Hanlin literary attendants, five posts, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin literary attendants, five posts, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 編修官十員，正八品；

translations.literal: Editing officials, ten posts, Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Editing officials, ten posts, Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 檢閱四員，正八品；

translations.literal: Proofreaders, four posts, Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Proofreaders, four posts, Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 典籍二員，正八品；

translations.literal: Keepers of records, two posts, Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Keepers of records, two posts, Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 經歷一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Administrative director, one post, Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: One administrative director, Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 都事一員，從七品；

translations.literal: Chief clerk, one post, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: One chief clerk, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史四人，譯史、通事、知印各二人，蒙古書寫五人，書寫十人，接手書寫十人，典吏三人，典書二人。

translations.literal: Four secretaries, two translators, two interpreters, and two seal keepers each, five Mongol scribes, ten scribes, ten assistant scribes, three record clerks, two archive clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The staff comprised four secretaries; two translators, interpreters, and seal keepers each; five Mongol scribes; ten scribes; ten assistant scribes; three record clerks; and two archive clerks.

sentences.zh: 蒙古翰林院，秩從二品，掌譯寫一切文字，及頒降璽書，並用蒙古新字，仍各以其國字副之。

translations.literal: The Mongol Hanlin Academy, rank Junior Second Rank, managed the translation of all documents, the issuance of imperial seals and patents, and the use of the new Mongol script, with each nation’s script appended as a supplement.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Hanlin Academy, ranked at Junior Second Rank, oversaw translation of all documents, issuance of imperial patents, and use of the new Mongol script, always accompanied by each realm’s native script.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，始立新字學士於國史院。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, academicians in the new script were first established in the National History Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 8 (1271), posts of academicians in the new script were first created within the National History Office.

sentences.zh: 十二年，別立翰林院，置承旨一員、直學士一員、待制二員、修撰一員、應奉四員、寫聖旨必阇赤十有一人、令史一人、知印一人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year a separate Hanlin Academy was established, with one grand preceptor, one regular academician, two attendants, one compiler-historian, four literary attendants, eleven bitikchi who wrote imperial rescripts, one clerk, and one seal keeper.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year a separate academy was founded with one grand preceptor, one regular academician, two attendants, one compiler-historian, four literary attendants, eleven bitikchi who drafted imperial rescripts, one clerk, and one seal keeper.

sentences.zh: 十八年，增承旨一員、學士三員，省漢兒令史，置蒙古必阇赤四人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year one grand preceptor and three academicians were added; Han clerks were cut and four Mongol bitikchi were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year one grand preceptor and three academicians were added, Han clerks were eliminated, and four Mongol bitikchi were appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，增承旨一員、侍讀學士一員、知印一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year one grand preceptor, one reader-academician, and one seal keeper were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year one grand preceptor, one reader-academician, and one seal keeper were added.

sentences.zh: 三十年，增管勾一員。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year one registrar was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year one registrar post was added.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，升正二品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade it was promoted to Senior Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 5 (1301) it was promoted to Senior Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 九年，置司直一員、都事一員。

translations.literal: In the ninth year one administrative inspector and one chief clerk were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year one administrative inspector and one chief clerk were appointed.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，改升從一品，設官二十有八，吏屬二十有四。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing it was further promoted to Junior First Rank, with twenty-eight officials and twenty-four clerical staff established.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 (1312) it was raised to Junior First Rank, with twenty-eight officials and twenty-four support staff.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，改司直為經歷。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou the administrative inspector was renamed administrative director.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 (1315) the administrative inspector was redesignated administrative director.

sentences.zh: 後定置承旨七員、學士二員、侍讀學士二員、侍講學士二員、直學士二員、待制四員、修撰二員、應奉五員、經歷一員、都事一員，品秩並同翰林國史院。

translations.literal: Later fixed establishment: seven grand preceptors, two academicians, two reader-academicians, two lecturer-academicians, two regular academicians, four attendants, two compiler-historians, five literary attendants, one administrative director, one chief clerk—ranks all the same as the Hanlin and National History Office.
translations.idiomatic: The later fixed establishment comprised seven grand preceptors, two academicians, two reader-academicians, two lecturer-academicians, two regular academicians, four attendants, two compiler-historians, five literary attendants, one administrative director, and one chief clerk, with ranks identical to those of the Hanlin and National History Office.

sentences.zh: 承發架閣庫管勾一員，正九品；

translations.literal: Registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository, one post, Senior Ninth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository: one post, Senior Ninth Rank;

sentences.zh: 必阇赤一十四人，掾史三人，通事一人，譯史一人，知印二人，書寫一人，典吏三人。

translations.literal: Fourteen bitikchi, three secretaries, one interpreter, one translator, two seal keepers, one scribe, three record clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen bitikchi, three secretaries, one interpreter, one translator, two seal keepers, one scribe, and three record clerks.

sentences.zh: 蒙古國子監，秩從三品。

translations.literal: The Mongol Imperial College, rank Junior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Imperial College held the rank of Junior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年始立，置司業一員。

translations.literal: It was first established in the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan, with one vice director appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Zhiyuan 14 (1277), it initially had one vice director.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，準漢人國學例，置祭酒、司業、監丞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, following the Han imperial college precedent, a chancellor of studies, vice directors, and a college supervisor were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, on the model of the Han imperial college, posts of chancellor of studies, vice directors, and college supervisor were created.

sentences.zh: 延祐四年，升正三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanyou it was promoted to Senior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 4 (1317) it was promoted to Senior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，復降為從三品。

translations.literal: In the seventh year it was again reduced to Junior Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year it was reduced again to Junior Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 後定置祭酒一員，從三品；

translations.literal: Later fixed establishment: one chancellor of studies, Junior Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Later fixed posts: chancellor of studies, one post, Junior Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 司業二員，正五品；

translations.literal: Vice directors, two posts, Senior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors: two posts, Senior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 監丞一員，正六品；

translations.literal: College supervisor, one post, Senior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: College supervisor: one post, Senior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 令史一人，必阇赤一人，知印一人。

translations.literal: One clerk, one bitikchi, one seal keeper.
translations.idiomatic: One clerk, one bitikchi, and one seal keeper.

sentences.zh: 蒙古國子學，秩正七品，博士二員，助教二員，教授二員，學正、學錄各二員，掌教習諸生。

translations.literal: The Mongol Imperial School, rank Senior Seventh Rank, with two erudites, two assistant erudites, two instructors, two rectifiers and two registrars each, who managed instruction of students.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Imperial School, rank Senior Seventh Rank, had two erudites, two assistant erudites, two instructors, and two rectifiers and registrars each, charged with teaching the students.

sentences.zh: 於隨朝百官、怯薛臺、蒙古、漢兒官員家，選子弟俊秀者入學。

translations.literal: From among the sons of officials at court, keshig guards, and Mongol and Han households, outstanding youths were selected for enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding sons were chosen from court officials, keshig guards, and Mongol and Han official families for admission.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，置官五員。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan five officials were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 8 five teaching officials were appointed.

sentences.zh: 後以每歲從駕上都，教習事繁，設官員少，增學正二員、學錄二員。

translations.literal: Later, because each year the court accompanied the emperor to Shangdu and instruction was burdensome while staff were few, two rectifiers and two registrars were added.
translations.idiomatic: Because the court annually moved to Shangdu, making instruction arduous while staff remained few, two rectifiers and two registrars were later added.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，增助教一員、典給一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year one assistant erudite and one provision steward were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year one assistant erudite and one provision steward were added.

sentences.zh: 後定置博士二員，正七品；

translations.literal: Later fixed establishment: two erudites, Senior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Later fixed posts: two erudites, Senior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 助教二員，教授二員，並正八品；

translations.literal: Two assistant erudites and two instructors, all Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Two assistant erudites and two instructors, all Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 學正、學錄各二員，典書一人，典給一人。

translations.literal: Two rectifiers and two registrars each, one archive clerk, one provision steward.
translations.idiomatic: Two rectifiers and two registrars each, plus one archive clerk and one provision steward.

sentences.zh: 內八府宰相，掌諸王朝覲儐介之事。

translations.literal: The Eight Inner Offices chancellors managed protocol for princely audiences and envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellors of the Eight Inner Offices handled audiences and protocol for the imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 遇有詔令，則與蒙古翰林院官同譯寫而潤色之。

translations.literal: When imperial orders were issued, they joined officials of the Mongol Hanlin Academy to translate and polish the text.
translations.idiomatic: When edicts were promulgated, they worked with Mongol Hanlin officials to translate and refine the wording.

sentences.zh: 謂之宰相雲者，其貴似侍中，其近似門下，故特寵之以是名。

translations.literal: They were called chancellors because their honor resembled that of Masters of Writing and their proximity resembled that of the Secretariat Gate; hence this title was specially bestowed upon them.
translations.idiomatic: They were styled chancellors because their standing was like that of Masters of Writing and their access like that of the Secretariat Gate—hence the special title.

sentences.zh: 雖有是名，而無授受宣命，品秩則視二品焉。

translations.literal: Although they bore this name, they received no formal appointment patent; their rank was treated as equivalent to Second Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Though so titled, they received no formal appointment patent; their standing was treated as equivalent to Second Rank.

sentences.zh: 大德九年，以滅怯禿等八人為之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Dade, Mieqietu and seven others were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 9 (1305), Mieqietu and seven others were appointed to these posts.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年，為內八府宰之職，故附見於此云。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun this became the office of the Eight Inner Offices chancellors; it is therefore recorded here.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 (1328) these posts became the chancellors of the Eight Inner Offices, and are therefore noted here.

sentences.zh: 集賢院，秩從二品，掌提調學校、征求隱逸、召集賢良，凡國子監、玄門道教、陰陽祭祀、占卜祭遁之事，悉隸焉。

translations.literal: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies, rank Junior Second Rank, supervised schools, sought out recluses, summoned the worthy, and had charge of the imperial college, Daoist and Buddhist clergy, yin-yang rites, divination, and esoteric arts.
translations.idiomatic: The Academy of Scholarly Worthies, rank Junior Second Rank, oversaw schools, sought hidden talent, summoned the worthy, and governed the imperial college, Daoist and Buddhist clergy, yin-yang sacrifices, divination, and esoteric practices.

sentences.zh: 國初，集賢與翰林國史院同一官署。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and the Hanlin and National History Office were a single agency.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty the Academy of Scholarly Worthies shared offices with the Hanlin and National History Office.

sentences.zh: 至元二十二年，分置兩院，置大學士三員、學士一員、直學士二員、典簿一員、吏屬七人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Zhiyuan the two academies were separated, with three grand academicians, one academician, two regular academicians, one registry clerk, and seven clerical staff appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 22 (1285) the two were split, with three grand academicians, one academician, two regular academicians, one registry clerk, and seven clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，增置學士一員、侍讀學士一員、待制一員。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year one academician, one reader-academician, and one attendant were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year one academician, one reader-academician, and one attendant were added.

sentences.zh: 尋升正二品，置院使一員，正二品；

translations.literal: Soon it was promoted to Senior Second Rank, with one academy director, Senior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: It was soon raised to Senior Second Rank, with one academy director at Senior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 大學士二員，從二品；

translations.literal: Grand academicians, two posts, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Grand academicians: two posts, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 學士三員，從二品；

translations.literal: Academicians, three posts, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Academicians: three posts, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士一員，從三品；

translations.literal: Reader-academician, one post, Junior Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Reader-academician: one post, Junior Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 侍講學士一員，從三品；

translations.literal: Lecturer-academician, one post, Junior Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer-academician: one post, Junior Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 直學士二員，從四品；

translations.literal: Regular academicians, two posts, Junior Fourth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Regular academicians: two posts, Junior Fourth Rank;

sentences.zh: 司直一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Administrative inspector, one post, Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Administrative inspector: one post, Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 待制一員，正五品。

translations.literal: Attendant, one post, Senior Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant: one post, Senior Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，增都事一員，從七品；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year one chief clerk was added, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year one chief clerk was added at Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 修撰一員，從六品。

translations.literal: One compiler-historian, Junior Sixth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: One compiler-historian at Junior Sixth Rank.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年，增院使一員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen one academy director was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanzhen 1 (1295) one academy director was added.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，升從一品，置院使六員、經歷二員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade it was promoted to Junior First Rank, with six academy directors and two administrative directors.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 (1307) it was promoted to Junior First Rank, with six academy directors and two administrative directors.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，省院使六員。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida six academy directors were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 (1311) six academy director posts were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，省漢人經歷一員。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing one Han administrative director was cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 2 (1313) one Han administrative director was cut.

sentences.zh: 後定置大學士五員，從一品；

translations.literal: Later fixed establishment: grand academicians, five posts, Junior First Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Later fixed posts: grand academicians, five posts, Junior First Rank;

sentences.zh: 學士二員，正二品；

translations.literal: Academicians, two posts, Senior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Academicians: two posts, Senior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士二員，侍講學士二員，並從二品；

translations.literal: Reader-academicians and lecturer-academicians, two posts each, Junior Second Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Reader-academicians and lecturer-academicians, two posts each, Junior Second Rank;

sentences.zh: 直學士二員，從三品；

translations.literal: Regular academicians, two posts, Junior Third Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Regular academicians: two posts, Junior Third Rank;

sentences.zh: 經歷一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Administrative director, one post, Junior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Administrative director: one post, Junior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 都事二員，從七品；

translations.literal: Chief clerks, two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks: two posts, Junior Seventh Rank;

sentences.zh: 待制一員，正五品；

translations.literal: Attendant, one post, Senior Fifth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Attendant: one post, Senior Fifth Rank;

sentences.zh: 修撰一員，從六品；

translations.literal: Compiler-historian, one post, Junior Sixth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Compiler-historian: one post, Junior Sixth Rank;

sentences.zh: 兼管勾承發架閣庫一員，正八品；

translations.literal: Concurrent registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository, one post, Senior Eighth Rank;
translations.idiomatic: Concurrent registrar of the Issuing and Filing Repository: one post, Senior Eighth Rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史六人，譯史、知印各二人，通事一人，宣使七人，典吏三人。

translations.literal: Six secretaries, two translators and two seal keepers each, one interpreter, seven dispatchers, three record clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Six secretaries; two translators and two seal keepers; one interpreter; seven dispatchers; three record clerks.

sentences.zh: 國子監。

translations.literal: The Imperial College.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial College.

sentences.zh: 至元初，以許衡為集賢館大學士、國子祭酒，教國子與蒙古大姓四怯薛人員。

translations.literal: Early in the Zhiyuan era Xu Heng was made grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and chancellor of the imperial college, teaching the imperial sons and members of the four great keshig houses.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhiyuan, Xu Heng served as grand academician of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and chancellor of the college, instructing imperial sons and members of the four great keshig lineages.

sentences.zh: 選七品以上朝官子孫為國子生，隨朝三品以上官得舉凡民之俊秀者入學，為陪堂生伴讀。

translations.literal: Sons of court officials of the seventh rank and above were selected as imperial students; officials of the third rank and above at court could recommend outstanding commoners for enrollment as companion readers.
translations.idiomatic: Sons of court officials of seventh rank and above became imperial students; third-rank officials at court could nominate outstanding commoners as companion readers.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，始置監祭酒一員，從三品，司業二員，正五品，掌國之教令，皆德尊望重者為之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan a college chancellor was first appointed, Junior Third Rank, with two vice directors at Senior Fifth Rank, to hold the state’s educational commands—all men of eminent virtue and reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 24 a college chancellor was first appointed at Junior Third Rank, with two vice directors at Senior Fifth Rank to uphold the state’s educational mandate—always men of eminent virtue.

sentences.zh: 監丞一員，正六品，專領監務。

translations.literal: College supervisor, one post, Senior Sixth Rank, who exclusively managed college affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A college supervisor at Senior Sixth Rank was charged exclusively with college administration.

sentences.zh: 典簿一員，令史二人，譯史、知印、典吏各一人。

translations.literal: One registry clerk, two clerks, and one translator, seal keeper, and record clerk each.
translations.idiomatic: One registry clerk, two clerks, and one translator, seal keeper, and record clerk each.

sentences.zh: 國子學，秩正七品。

translations.literal: The Imperial School, rank Senior Seventh Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial School ranked at Senior Seventh Rank.

sentences.zh: 置博士二員，掌教授生徒、考較儒人著述、教官所業文字。

translations.literal: Two erudites were appointed to instruct students and examine the scholarly writings and teaching records of the instructors.
translations.idiomatic: Two erudites instructed students and evaluated the scholarly writings and teaching records of the faculty.

sentences.zh: 助教四員，分教各齋生員。

translations.literal: Four assistant erudites divided instruction among students in the various halls.
translations.idiomatic: Four assistant erudites taught students in the separate halls.

sentences.zh: 大德八年，為分職上都，增置助教二員、學正二員、學錄二員，督習課業。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dade, to divide duties at Shangdu, two assistant erudites, two rectifiers, and two registrars were added to supervise coursework.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 8 (1304), to staff instruction at Shangdu, two assistant erudites, two rectifiers, and two registrars were added to supervise coursework.

sentences.zh: 典給一員，掌生員膳食。

translations.literal: One provision steward managed students’ meals.
translations.idiomatic: One provision steward managed the students’ board.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，定置生員額二百人、伴讀二十人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan the quota was fixed at two hundred students and twenty companion readers.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 24 the quota was set at two hundred students and twenty companion readers.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，生員三百人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida there were three hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 (1311) the student quota reached three hundred.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，增置生員一百人、伴讀二十人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou one hundred students and twenty companion readers were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 (1315) one hundred students and twenty companion readers were added.

sentences.zh: 興文署，秩從六品。

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，建龍翔、萬壽兩寺於建康，立龍翔萬壽營繕提點所，為隆祥總管府屬。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun the Longxiang and Longevity temples were built at Jiankang, and a construction intendant office was established as subordinate to the Longxiang General Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 2 the Longxiang and Longevity temples were built at Jiankang with a construction intendant office under Longxiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，改為營繕都司，秩仍舊，以掌營造錢糧之事。

translations.literal: In the third year it was changed to the Construction General Directorate, rank unchanged, managing construction funds and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it became the Construction General Directorate, managing construction funds and grain.

sentences.zh: 定置達魯花赤、司令、大使、副使各一員，知事、提控案牘各一員。

translations.literal: Fixed establishment: one darughachi, director, commissioner, and vice commissioner each, one administrative officer and document controller each.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed posts: darughachi, director, commissioner, vice commissioner, administrative officer, document controller.

sentences.zh: 宣農提舉司，秩從五品，達魯花赤、提舉、同提舉、副提舉各一員，掌征收田賦子粒之事。

translations.literal: The Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office, rank Junior Fifth Rank, with one darughachi, intendant, associate intendant, and vice intendant each, managing collection of field tax grain.
translations.idiomatic: The Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office, rank Junior Fifth Rank, collected field taxes with standard intendant staff.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，以大都等處田賦提舉司隸隆祥總管府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun the Dadu Field Tax Intendant Office was placed under the Longxiang General Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 2 the Dadu Field Tax Intendant Office was subordinated to Longxiang.

sentences.zh: 三年，改提舉司。

translations.literal: In the third year it was renamed the intendant office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it was renamed the intendant office.

sentences.zh: 護聖營繕司，秩正五品，達魯花赤、司令、大使、副使各一員，掌營造工匠、寺僧衣糧、收征房課之事。

translations.literal: The Protecting Sage Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank, with one darughachi, director, commissioner, and vice commissioner each, managing craftsmen, monks’ provisions, and collection of building rents.
translations.idiomatic: The Protecting Sage Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank, managed craftsmen, monks’ provisions, and building rents.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，始立大承天護聖營繕提點所。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianshun the Great Supporting Heaven and Protecting Sage Construction Intendant Office was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 2 the Great Protecting Sage Construction Intendant Office was founded.

sentences.zh: 三年，改為司。

translations.literal: In the third year it was changed to a directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it became a directorate.

sentences.zh: 平江善農提舉司，秩從五品，達魯花赤、提舉、同提舉、副提舉各一員，天歷二年，立田賦提舉司，設官四員。

translations.literal: The Pingjiang Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office, rank Junior Fifth Rank, with one darughachi, intendant, associate intendant, and vice intendant each; in the second year of Tianshun a field tax intendant office was established with four officials.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office, rank Junior Fifth Rank; in Tianshun 2 a field tax office with four officials was founded.

sentences.zh: 三年，改為善農提舉司。

translations.literal: In the third year it was renamed the Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it was renamed the Promoting Agriculture Intendant Office.

sentences.zh: 善盈庫，天歷二年，隸隆祥總管府，置提領一員，大使、副使各一員，掌金銀錢糧之事。

translations.literal: The Shanying Treasury: in the second year of Tianshun it was subordinate to the Longxiang General Directorate, with one intendant, one commissioner, one vice commissioner, managing gold, silver, money, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanying Treasury, subordinate to Longxiang from Tianshun 2, had intendant, commissioner, and vice commissioner managing gold, silver, and funds.

sentences.zh: 荊襄等處濟農香戶提舉司，秩正五品。

translations.literal: The Jingxiang and other regions Relief Agriculture Incense Households Intendant Office, rank Senior Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Households Intendant Office, rank Senior Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年，以荊襄提舉司所領河南、湖廣田土為大承天護聖寺常住，改為荊襄濟農香戶提舉司，隸隆祥總管府，置達魯花赤、司令、提舉、同提舉、副提舉各一員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianshun the Jingxiang intendant office’s Henan and Huguang lands were made permanent endowment of the Great Protecting Sage Temple; it was renamed the Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Households Intendant Office, subordinate to Longxiang, with one darughachi, director, intendant, associate intendant, and vice intendant each.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 3 Jingxiang’s Henan and Huguang lands became temple endowment; the office was renamed and subordinated to Longxiang with full staff.

sentences.zh: 龍慶州等處田賦提領所，秩九品，提領、副提領各一員。

translations.literal: The Longqing Prefecture Field Tax Intendant Office, rank Ninth Rank: one intendant and one vice intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing Field Tax Intendant Office, rank Ninth Rank: one intendant, one vice intendant.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年置，掌龍慶州所有土田歲賦。

translations.literal: Established in the second year of Tianshun, managing annual field tax from all lands in Longqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Tianshun 2, it collected Longqing Prefecture’s annual field tax.

sentences.zh: 平江集慶崇禧田賦提領所，提領、同提領、副提領各一員。

translations.literal: The Pingjiang Jiqing Chongxi Field Tax Intendant Office: one intendant, associate intendant, and vice intendant each.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang Jiqing Chongxi Field Tax Intendant Office: intendant, associate intendant, vice intendant.

sentences.zh: 天曆三年始置。

translations.literal: First established in the third year of Tianli.
translations.idiomatic: First established in Tianli 3 (1330).

sentences.zh: 集慶崇禧財用所，大使、副使各一員。

translations.literal: The Jiqing Chongxi Resources Office: one commissioner and one vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Jiqing Chongxi Resources Office: one commissioner, one vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年始置。

translations.literal: First established in the third year of Tianshun.
translations.idiomatic: First established in Tianshun 3.

sentences.zh: 萬安營繕司，秩正五品。

translations.literal: The Wan’an Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Wan’an Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 天歷三年，以萬安規運提點所既廢，復立萬安營繕司，定置達魯花赤、司令、大使、副使、都目各一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianshun, after the Wan’an Transport Regulation Intendant Office was abolished, the Wan’an Construction Directorate was re-established with one darughachi, director, commissioner, vice commissioner, and chief clerk each.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 3, after the Wan’an transport office was abolished, the construction directorate was re-established with full staff.

sentences.zh: 延聖營繕司，秩正五品。

translations.literal: The Yansheng Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Yansheng Construction Directorate, rank Senior Fifth Rank.

sentences.zh: 初立天源營繕提點所，天歷三年，改營繕司。

translations.literal: Initially the Tianyuan Construction Intendant Office was established; in the third year of Tianshun it was changed to a construction directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianyuan Construction Intendant Office was founded first; in Tianshun 3 it became a directorate.

sentences.zh: 定置達魯花赤、司令、大使、副使、都目各一員。

translations.literal: Fixed establishment: one darughachi, director, commissioner, vice commissioner, and chief clerk each.
translations.idiomatic: Fixed posts: darughachi, director, commissioner, vice commissioner, chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 諸物庫，提領一員，大使一員。

translations.literal: Various Goods Storehouse: one intendant, one commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Various Goods Storehouse: one intendant, one commissioner.
